qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Indispensable UK primary healthcare facilities backed by NHS GP tenant reimbursements; unlevered ROIC of 4-5% fails 12% hurdle, and rental growth is strictly tethered to NHS District Valuer budgetary agreements rather than pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 4.5%, REJECT). NHS-backed GP surgery portfolio provides secure rental cash flows but delivers sub-5% unlevered ROIC. Rent growth is constrained by government District Valuer budgets and fails to beat inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Primary Health Properties holds ~500 primary healthcare facilities valued at £2.8B across the UK and Ireland with 99%+ occupancy and ~10-year WAULT. Over 89% of rent roll is funded directly or indirectly by the NHS/HSE. However, portfolio net initial yield is ~5.2%, resulting in GAAP ROIC of 4-5% (well below the 12% hurdle). Net debt/EBITDA is elevated at ~9.3x-9.4x (net debt ~£1.3B, LTV ~48%). Rental growth reviews average 1.5-2.5% p.a., lagging inflation spikes.
